$comment: GROUND TRUTH for plan 07: a human estimator's quantities for a real bid.
Phase 07 exists because 'every accuracy claim in the legacy repo is
self-consistency — agreement with a human estimator has never been
measured'. This is the missing half. It is not another capture from the Qt
build, which would only prove the two builds agree with each other; it is
what a person quoted, off the same drawings, for money.
Read from the quotation PDF in the project folder with a crude content-
stream extractor, so the numbers below were TRANSCRIBED and should be
re-checked against the PDF before anything is published from them.
Prices are deliberately not recorded per line. This is a quantity oracle;
the totals are here for provenance only.
REDACTED 2026-09-04 for a public repository: the quoted total, the currency and the estimator who signed it. Nothing that the oracle asserts was touched.

The tags here (CL02..CL05) are the quote's. The scopes currently in the
app's Barclays project are named differently (C-MT-01, CL03, FIX-01,
LV-04, WP-12) and only CL03 matches by name, so a comparison has to map
them deliberately rather than by string.
A quoted quantity is not automatically the true one. It is what a person
arrived at and was prepared to be paid against, which is a different and
more useful thing than a second machine's answer: where the app disagrees,
the disagreement has to be explained, not assumed to be the app's error.
